description: Creative-mode PPT pipeline. One full-page 16:9 PNG per slide. LLM / VLM calls go through sn-ppt-standard/lib/model_client.py (shared thin client). Text-to-image (the actual png rendering) goes through sn-image-base/scripts/sn_agent_runner.py. Falls back to web image search when T2I generation fails. Expects task_pack.json + info_pack.json already written by sn-ppt-entry.
